title: In Yealink Plug-in Softwares before 2.35.219.0, there is an unauthorized file write vulnerability under specific…
description: Yealink Plug-in Softwares prior to version 2.35.219.0 contain an unauthorized file write vulnerability that can be exploited under certain conditions to achieve remote code execution. This vulnerability is critical and has a high CVSS score of 9.0, indicating severe impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
